To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel "identifier critic" IRL scheme with stabilizing term in update law for simultaneous identification and tracking control of unknown continuous time nonlinear systems is presented in the paper.
we present an IRL based optimal tracking control algorithm with simultaneous identifier for continuous time nonlinear system.

we propose a novel IRL based update law with variable learning rate for simultaneous identification and optimal trajectory tracking of unknown continuous time nonlinear systems in presence of actuator constraints.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (1) Simultaneous identification and optimal control of unknown nonlinear systems using IRL framework; (2) Leveraging the variable learning rate update law in IRL framework for optimal tracking control; and (3) Utilizing the ER technique in IRL framework to efficiently learn the critic and identifier NN weights.
simultaneous identification of unknown dynamics along with optimal control of continuous time nonlinear systems using a single NN.
simultaneous identification and optimal trajectory tracking of unknown continuous time nonlinear systems in presence of actuator constraints.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the presented "identifier-critic" framework with novel update laws is capable of solving optimal trajectory tracking problem with actuator constraints for continuous time nonlinear system without requiring any information on control coupling dynamics.

the presented "identifier-critic" framework with simultaneous identification of unknown dynamics and control coupling is capable of simultaneously identifying unknown dynamics and control laws with optimal tracking control for continuous time nonlinear system with actuator constraints.

the presented IRL framework with stabilizing term and variable gain update law along with ER technique is able to simultaneously identify unknown nonlinear systems with unknown drift dynamics and optimal tracking of unknown continuous time nonlinear systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presented "identifier-critic" framework is capable of simultaneously learning the unknown system dynamics and optimal control policy with actuator constraints for nonlinear systems.
we have proposed a novel "identifier critic" update law for continuous time nonlinear system in IRL framework with simultaneous identifier to solve optimal trajectory control problem.
the presented algorithm simultaneously learns the system dynamics and optimal control policy with the help of ER and variable learning rate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed update law is able to simultaneously learn the system dynamics and optimal control law for unknown continuous time nonlinear systems.

the proposed "identifier critic" update law can be used in both ADP and IRL framework to simultaneously solve the problems of identification, stabilization and optimal control of continuous time nonlinear systems.

the presented update law with stabilising term can be utilized for online learning of optimal tracking control policy for continuous time unknown nonlinear systems without requiring the knowledge of control coupling dynamics and initial stabilising controller.
